name: @tripfolio/contracts
description: Tripfolio API 契约：OpenAPI 源文件、打包结果、TypeScript 类型与跨语言测试样例

scripts.admin:build: redocly lint openapi/admin/openapi.yaml && redocly bundle openapi/admin/openapi.yaml -o dist/openapi.admin.yaml && openapi-typescript dist/openapi.admin.yaml -o generated/openapi.admin.d.ts --export-type --alphabetize
scripts.build: pnpm lint && pnpm bundle && pnpm gen:ts && pnpm admin:build
scripts.check: pnpm build && git diff --exit-code -- dist generated
